prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: final scene-only wide website hero background for GG PC, in its established FIRE RED gaming brand.
Input image: previous wide workbench layout shot is a COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. Carry forward the positions and tangible hardware proportions, but replace its entire pale palette, lighting, environment, and incidental props. The pale reference is superseded and must NOT influence the new colors.
Primary request: create a premium dark hardware workbench photograph-illustration, wide landscape aspect ratio approximately 2.2:1, ideally 1862 by 845 pixels or 1536 by 698 pixels. It must fill this wide frame with complete PC component silhouettes, no cropping of major components and no letterboxing.
Brand color contract: base near-black #0D0D0D and subtle dark red #1A0A0A. Physically motivated saturated hot red/pink #FF0040 rim lighting as primary, restrained fiery orange #FF4D00 secondary edge highlights, a few tiny warm #FFB800 metallic reflections at most. Match a confident Fire Red gaming identity. No pale/white/gray desk and no daylight office atmosphere.
Composition: LEFT 42 PERCENT is clean, empty, matte near-black #0D0D0D, uniformly dark enough for semantic white headline, body text, and a signup form. Do not place any parts or bright light in this left reading field. The RIGHT 58 PERCENT contains the tangible build scene. At far right x=73–96 percent, a substantial black mid-tower PC case stands fully visible, from y=5 to y=93 percent, almost the full scene height. Gently oblique elevated product-photography viewpoint, black fine mesh front with three fans, dark tempered glass side, mesh top. Motherboard lies on the dark matte workbench at x=44–63 percent, from upper quarter to lower half, detailed realistic CPU socket, dense circuitry, metallic connectors and black heatsinks. Two black RAM sticks lie vertically just to its right, x=64–70 percent, y=27–55 percent. Separate chunky black triple-fan graphics card near lower middle-right, x=50–74 percent, y=72–94 percent, horizontally with a subtle diagonal, all three fans clearly readable. One small dark red screwdriver and a few screws near the upper-right edge; minimal incidental workbench details only.
Lighting and fidelity: cinematic directional studio product lighting, premium photographic detail. A controlled neutral low key light reveals hardware faces and every fan, fine mesh, circuitry and anodized metal. Harder hot red/pink light from upper-right/back catches hardware bevels, case mesh edges and motherboard components. Restrained orange light from lower-right creates distinct warm edge reflections. These are believable lights on physical objects, not glowing decorations. Keep the scene dark but do not lose the hardware shapes or details in crushed blacks. Rich blacks, restrained contrast, subtle natural contact shadows, tactile crisp metal and glass.
Text: absolutely none.
Constraints: all four principal PC components remain recognizable and complete inside the wide frame. No logo, no brand name, no labels, no numbered annotations, no pointer lines, no headings, no UI, no forms, no controls, no watermark. No plants, coffee mugs, domestic desk decorations, people or hands. No diffuse neon blobs, decorative RGB swirls, floating particles, neon rings, glowing fog, gradients across the reading field, or broad colored glows detached from hardware. This asset is real tangible scene imagery; website typography and interface will be implemented separately.
